items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: We went up and we made poor Ernest Kelly, so now we're scared of Ernest Kelly, they beat us up, you know.

ctx.x: Got to live on a little fine baby voice.

So, man comes to get up. Don't want to try to change your voice. I said, get up. We said, well, don't try to change your voice. Get up out of that bed. We said, buddy, she was going to put us all up in the rain. Where was this? In the, in the, in the blues, on the Fangle, Louisiana. Oh, yeah, we played Fangle. It's a storming, man. We went up and we made poor Ernest Kelly, so now we're scared of Ernest Kelly, they beat us up, you know. So we went over and they said, one, the bar on one side and the girls on the…
Listen at him. Talk like you was talking last night.
